section_summary.extract_value: This section details the recruitment and demographic characteristics of participants for a single study. Participants were recruited via local newspaper and university mailing lists, with inclusion criteria of age 18-55, German mother tongue, and no neurological/mental disorders. The final sample consisted of 297 respondents (101 males) with an average age of 30.40 years, and varying education levels.
